[RDSC.16.3.7] **Body revisions vs registry.** The atom registry
([RDSC.7.1]) tracks which atoms exist and their field numbers, not
body-proto revisions. The compact node-cap encoding ([RTCT.6.7]) adds
fields 11–14 to the `RealtimeContract` body; because `RealtimeContract` already
exists in the registry and the encoding is gated on the
`realtime` capability with an encoding-independent hash
([RBND.4b.8]), it is a **body revision**, not a registry change,
and adds no registry row. A runtime that does not understand the
compact encoding is unaffected on non-`realtime` bundles, and
rejects a compact `realtime` contract structurally per
[RTCT.6.7.6].
